snippet.title: DECRYPTO Project - Trailer
snippet.description:
Our algorithm has chosen you for inclusion in the DECRYPTO project. Your job is simple: we send encrypted texts, you decipher them. Loyalty and diligence will be rewarded with upgrades and customization options for your system. Disobedience and sabotage will be punished.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565680/DECRYPTO_Project/
